name: Idol ga Totsuzen Yattekite Koibito ni Naru Hanashi
original_name: アイドルが突然やってきて恋人になる話
source:
Finally I purchased the idol photo album that I'd wanted, 
and my heart heart skipped as I ran home to look at it, but I had a visitor! 
W-w-what the-- it's the very girl whose album I bought! 
The real thing! My favorite idol! 
Pinch me, I must be dreaming... 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ103957.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
终于买到了想要的偶像写真集，
我跑回家一看，心头一跳，竟然有客人来了！
什、什、什么——这就是我买专辑的那个女孩！
真实的事情！我最喜欢的偶像！
掐我一下，我一定是在做梦…… 

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ103957.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
